reviews.text: These are even cuter in person. They arrived clean and protected in a resealable zip-top bag, which I really liked. You don’t have to cut the packaging open, so I’m keeping the bags to store the covers in after Halloween.Right out of the package they were extremely soft. There was a very subtle new-fabric smell, but nothing strong or unpleasant. The raised ghosts are actually fluffy and dimensional, rather than just being a printed design, and the black embroidered faces give them a really cute 3D look. The back has a smooth, almost suede-like feel.The covers feel sturdy and the stitching looks good. The zipper is small and discreet, so you really don’t notice it when it’s closed. Looking at the inside, I did notice a few loose ends from the black embroidery, but they don’t affect the appearance from the outside.One thing I wish they had included is a care-instruction tag. There isn’t one sewn into the covers, so you’ll need to refer back to the listing, which says to machine wash cold on gentle and tumble dry low.I also agree with the listing’s “spooky neutral” description. They’re Halloween-themed without being bright or overly cartoonish, so they’re easy to work into regular home decor. The listing mentions using them on a porch, but personally I wouldn’t. The white plush material and embroidery feel much better suited to indoor use, especially if you want to keep them looking nice.I bought the 18x18 set of two, and I would absolutely buy more for my other throw pillows. I especially like that there are different sizes and colors available, so I can mix and match while keeping the same ghost theme.For the price I paid, I’m very happy with the quality.
